```yaml
name: Godot Addon Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
            arch: x86_64
            target: linux
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
            arch: x86_64
            target: macos
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
            arch: arm64
            target: macos
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: windows
            arch: x86_64
            target: windows

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout amy
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout Godot source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: godotengine/godot
          path: godot
          ref: 4.2-stable

      - name: Setup MSVC (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1

      - name: Build Godot Editor (Linux)
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          cd godot
          scons platform=linuxbsd target=editor arch=${{ matrix.arch }} -j$(nproc)

      - name: Build Godot Editor (macOS)
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        run: |
          cd godot
          scons platform=macos target=editor arch=${{ matrix.arch }} -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)

      - name: Build Godot Editor (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        run: |
          cd godot
          scons platform=windows target=editor arch=${{ matrix.arch }} -j$env:NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS

      - name: Build Amy Addon (Linux)
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DAMY_BUILD_GODOT=ON \
            -DAMY_GODOT_SOURCE_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot \
            -DAMY_GODOT_TARGET=editor \
            -DAMY_GODOT_PLATFORM=linuxbsd \
            -DAMY_GODOT_ARCH=${{ matrix.arch }} \
            -DAMY_GODOT_BIN_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot/bin
          cmake --build . --config Release
          # Copy library to addon structure
          mkdir -p ../amy_godot_addon/bin/linux
          cp libamy_godot.so ../amy_godot_addon/bin/linux/

      - name: Build Amy Addon (macOS)
        if: matrix.platform == 'macos'
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DAMY_BUILD_GODOT=ON \
            -DAMY_GODOT_SOURCE_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot \
            -DAMY_GODOT_TARGET=editor \
            -DAMY_GODOT_PLATFORM=macos \
            -DAMY_GODOT_ARCH=${{ matrix.arch }} \
            -DAMY_GODOT_BIN_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot/bin
          cmake --build . --config Release
          # Copy library to addon structure
          mkdir -p ../amy_godot_addon/bin/macos
          cp libamy_godot.dylib ../amy_godot_addon/bin/macos/

      - name: Build Amy Addon (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        run: |
          mkdir build
          cd build
          cmake .. `
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release `
            -DAMY_BUILD_GODOT=ON `
            -DAMY_GODOT_SOURCE_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot `
            -DAMY_GODOT_TARGET=editor `
            -DAMY_GODOT_PLATFORM=windows `
            -DAMY_GODOT_ARCH=${{ matrix.arch }} `
            -DAMY_GODOT_BIN_DIR=${{ github.workspace }}/godot/bin
          cmake --build . --config Release
          # Copy library to addon structure
          mkdir ..\amy_godot_addon\bin\windows
          copy amy_godot.dll ..\amy_godot_addon\bin\windows\

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-godot-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: amy_godot_addon/

  package:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout amy
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Merge Addons
        run: |
          mkdir -p amy_godot_addon_final
          # Copy common files (assuming they are in the repo root or a specific dir)
          # For this example, we assume the addon structure is built in the artifacts
          # We need to merge the bin directories from different platforms
          
          # Create base structure
          mkdir -p amy_godot_addon_final/bin/linux
          mkdir -p amy_godot_addon_final/bin/macos
          mkdir -p amy_godot_addon_final/bin/windows
          
          # Copy Linux
          cp artifacts/amy-godot-addon-linux-x86_64/bin/linux/* amy_godot_addon_final/bin/linux/
          # Copy macOS x86_64
          cp artifacts/amy-godot-addon-macos-x86_64/bin/macos/* amy_godot_addon_final/bin/macos/
          # Copy macOS arm64 (if needed, usually Godot handles universal or specific arch)
          # If we want to keep them separate or merge, let's assume we keep the last one or merge.
          # For simplicity, let's just ensure the directories exist. 
          # Note: Godot addons often require specific naming or structure.
          # Let's copy the plugin.cfg and other non-bin files from one of the artifacts
          cp artifacts/amy-godot-addon-linux-x86_64/* amy_godot_addon_final/
          
          # Copy Windows
          cp artifacts/amy-godot-addon-windows-x86_64/bin/windows/* amy_godot_addon_final/bin/windows/

      - name: Create Zip
        run: |
          cd amy_godot_addon_final
          zip -r ../amy-godot-addon.zip .

      - name: Upload Release Asset
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: amy-godot-addon.zip
          tag_name: v0.0.1-${{ github.run_number }}
          name: Godot Addon Build ${{ github.run_number }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: true
```
